title: event-envelope.v1
description: The shared wrapper for every ApexVoid Kafka business-event record. Topic payload schemas describe only the `payload` object; this schema owns the metadata wrapper once. A producer or consumer decodes this envelope before its event-specific payload. Go implementation: internal/transport/kafka.Envelope.

event_id.description: A unique, time-sortable UUIDv7 for this event instance. It is for tracing and log correlation, not a replacement for a payload's lifecycle identity.

event_type.description: The Kafka business-event topic name this event was published to, and therefore which payload schema `payload` must validate against — for example "analysis.opportunity.v1". Must match the topic's own name exactly.

event_version.description: The payload contract version, redundant with (and must agree with) the "vN" suffix already present in event_type — carried separately so a consumer can branch on it without string-parsing the topic name.

occurred_at.description: Unix seconds. The domain moment this business event represents — for example, the moment an opportunity was identified. Never milliseconds; never mixed with produced_at's unit.

produced_at.description: Unix seconds — wall-clock time the producing service actually published this record. May differ from occurred_at (processing latency); produced_at >= occurred_at is expected but not schema-enforced (semantic validation, not structural).

producer.description: Which service produced this event — e.g. "ctrader-engine", "analysis-engine". Free-form but must match an actual known service name; not schema-enumerated here because this schema is shared before every producer exists.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end trace identifier, propagated unchanged across a derived business-event chain. A root event still carries a freshly generated value.

causation_id.description: The event_id of the specific business event that directly caused this one. Omitted for a root event with no event parent. Distinct from correlation_id: correlation_id is shared across a chain; causation_id points to one immediate parent.

config_version.description: Configuration V3 schema version that produced this event's payload when the payload reflects configured engine behavior, such as analysis.opportunity.v1. Never a secret value.

config_fingerprint.description: A content hash of the resolved Configuration V3 document that produced this event, alongside config_version — together they answer "which exact configuration generated this opportunity?" historically. Never a secret value; the fingerprint is a hash, not the configuration content itself.

payload.description: The event-type-specific body. Validate against event_type's own business-event payload schema. This remains generic because the envelope owns only wrapper metadata.
